t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When you get a round with a lot of mushrooms use that colour on the 5x multiplier rounds, though sometimes it switches to opposite during some rounds so try to notice a pattern.

vb_textbox.text: When you get to a 5x round focus on the colour of the basket and remember the colours of gnome you selected. If that colour combination give you a high amount then try and use it to help you pick up the pattern in the following tries. The pattern which scores high amounts appears to switch up for example sometimes matching the gnome with the basket colour on 5x round yields high results, other times it is the opposite.
